subject: OlivePay pilot — tiered per-token bands + model mix opt-in
messages:
From: Sarah Thompson <sarah.thompson@olivepay.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@olivepay.com
Date: Thu, 15 Jan 2026 09:12:00 -0500
Subject: Clarify pricing structure for pilot (tokens, models, commits)

Hi Mina —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. The team is excited, and procurement asked me to get a clearer view on how Redwood would structure pricing for a 3-month pilot. A few specific asks:

- How do per-token volume discounts apply if we mix premium chat models (higher-quality) with standard models?
- Are embeddings priced differently for usage vs chat/text generation?
- Do you have a minimum commit band to qualify for deeper discounts?

We'd like a simple example for a pilot: ~40M tokens/month (mixed 60% chat premium / 30% standard chat / 10% embeddings). Can you show a ballpark of per-token rates at different commit levels?

Also attaching our standard procurement requirements. Happy to hop on a quick call if easier.

Thanks,
Sarah
Sarah Thompson
Head of AI Integrations | OlivePay
[sarah.thompson@olivepay.com]


From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sarah Thompson <sarah.thompson@olivepay.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Jan 2026 11:07:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Clarify pricing structure for pilot (tokens, models, commits)

Hi Sarah —

Great questions — thanks for the detail. I put together a short breakdown and attached a one-page pricing sheet (olivepay_pricing-sheet_v1.pdf) plus a draft SOW for a 3-month pilot. High level:

1) Model tiers and multipliers
   - Standard chat models: base per-token rate (R_base).
   - Premium chat models: 1.8x multiplier over R_base (reflects higher compute & priority routing).
   - Embeddings: billed per-embedding-unit; typically ~0.6x of R_base for equivalent token volume.

2) Commit bands (monthly committed tokens)
   - <25M tokens: on-demand rates (no commit discount).
   - 25M–75M: 10% discount on blended per-token usage if committed.
   - 75M–200M: 18% discount.
   - >200M: custom pricing and SLA conversation.

3) Mixed-model math (example using your 40M/month):
   - Blended base tokens: 40M * (0.6*1.0 + 0.3*1.8 + 0.1*0.6) = blended multiplier ~1.12x of R_base
   - If OlivePay commits to 40M/month (falls in 25M–75M band), apply 10% discount to the blended per-token rate.

4) Commit flexibility
   - We allow a 10% month-to-month variance before true-up.
   - Pilot commit can be structured as monthly minimum or a 3-month lump commit (we typically prefer lump commits for straightforward billing).

I'll let Karthik and Jordan add any engineering/ops notes (cold-start, KV cache benefits for chats, and embedding throughput).

If this looks directionally correct I'll follow up with a clear numeric example (USD/token) and a short SOW.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com

Attachment: olivepay_pricing-sheet_v1.pdf
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>, Sarah Thompson <sarah.thompson@olivepay.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 17 Jan 2026 16:30:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Clarify pricing structure for pilot (tokens, models, commits)

Thanks Mina — adding a couple of infra/ops considerations that affect effective unit cost:

- Prefix/KV cache: for chat-heavy workloads with repeated context, effective tokens billed at runtime can be reduced with caching. We often model a 5–12% effective token reduction for multi-turn flows depending on prompt design. That can materially reduce the blended spend for your 60% chat portion.
- Batching and concurrency: embeddings jobs are often highly parallel; we can suggest an optimal concurrency setting and quantization profile that reduces cost per embedding by ~15% vs naive runs.
- Premium model SLAs: premium models get priority routing and are charged at the multiplier Mina mentioned; however, when premium capacity is constrained we can offer an agreed fallback to a near-equivalent standard model at a reduced multiplier (helps avoid tail-latency and cost spikes).

I'll coordinate with ops to include estimated effective token reductions in the numeric example.

-Karthik
Director, Platform Solutions | Redwood Inference

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sarah Thompson <sarah.thompson@olivepay.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Jan 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Clarify pricing structure for pilot (tokens, models, commits)

Folks — quick technical clarification on embeddings billing:

- We surface embeddings as a per-request unit that maps to internal token-equivalent charges for compute. For simplicity in contracts we can present embeddings pricing as either a) a flat per-embedding request fee, or b) an equivalent per-token rate (we default to the per-embedding fee for procurement clarity).
- For OlivePay's mix, if you expect large batch offline embeddings (e.g., 4M embeddings run as a job), we can price that as a time-windowed consumption at a discounted execution slab (effective discount often 12–20% vs streaming per-request).

If you want, I can convert the blended example Mina described into two scenarios: interactive/real-time monthly usage vs batch/ingest jobs. That will show where you can save by scheduling large embedding runs in off-peak windows.

-Jordan
Principal Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sarah Thompson <sarah.thompson@olivepay.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Jan 2026 09:00:00 -0800
Subject: OlivePay pilot — numeric example and next steps

Hi Sarah —

Attached is a short numeric example (olivepay_pricing-sheet_v1.pdf) and a draft SOW (olivepay_sow_draft.docx). Highlights:

- Example blended rates (USD per 1k tokens, illustrative):
   * R_base = $0.45 / 1k tokens (standard chat)
   * Premium chat = $0.81 / 1k tokens (1.8x)
   * Embeddings = $0.27 / 1k-token-equivalent (0.6x)

- For 40M tokens/month with your mix (60/30/10), blended pre-discount = $50,400/month.
- With a 25M–75M commit (10% discount) -> $45,360/month.
- If you run embeddings as a one-time batch job and we apply a 15% embedding execution discount, blended monthly drops ~3% further.

Pilot commercial options:
A) Month-to-month commit at 40M (10% discount), 10% variance allowance, billed monthly.
B) 3-month lump commit (120M total) with a 12% effective discount and a 30% cap on credits for unused tokens at program end.

Next steps we propose:
- Confirm preferred commit vehicle (A or B).
- Procurement: we share standard T&Cs + SOW; OlivePay sends any redlines.
- Technical kickoff: 1-hour workshop with Jordan and ops to discuss batching/embedding windowing.

If this looks OK I'll ask legal/finance to generate a formal quote.

Best,
Mina

Attachment: olivepay_pricing-sheet_v1.pdf, olivepay_sow_draft.docx

Sarah
